import numpy as np

ref_path = r"C:\Users\sandeeppawar\Downloads\aida-eval\data\file_generation_en\reference\FG_71\adjusted_designated_shipment_statistics_report_desensitized_res.xlsx"

# Strategy: Compare data content by aligning columns by name
# This checks if cell values are unchanged (regardless of column order)

def compare_dataframes_by_column_name(ref_df, pred_df, sheet_name):
    """Compare two dataframes by aligning columns by name"""
    
    # Check if they have the same columns (regardless of order)
    ref_cols_set = set(ref_df.columns)
    pred_cols_set = set(pred_df.columns)
    
    if ref_cols_set != pred_cols_set:
        print(f"{sheet_name}: Column sets don't match!")
        print(f"  Missing in pred: {ref_cols_set - pred_cols_set}")
        print(f"  Extra in pred: {pred_cols_set - ref_cols_set}")
        return False
    
    # Reorder pred_df columns to match ref_df
    pred_df_aligned = pred_df[ref_df.columns]
    
    # Compare shapes
    if ref_df.shape != pred_df_aligned.shape:
        print(f"{sheet_name}: Shapes don't match! Ref: {ref_df.shape}, Pred: {pred_df_aligned.shape}")
        return False
    
    # Sample comparison: first 10 rows, last 10 rows
    sample_indices = list(range(min(10, len(ref_df)))) + list(range(max(0, len(ref_df)-10), len(ref_df)))
    sample_indices = sorted(set(sample_indices))
    
    differences = []
    for idx in sample_indices:
        for col in ref_df.columns:
            ref_val = ref_df.iloc[idx][col]
            pred_val = pred_df_aligned.iloc[idx][col]
            
            # Handle NaN comparison
            if pd.isna(ref_val) and pd.isna(pred_val):
                continue
            elif pd.isna(ref_val) or pd.isna(pred_val):
                differences.append(f"Row {idx}, Col {col}: ref={ref_val}, pred={pred_val}")
            elif isinstance(ref_val, (int, float)) and isinstance(pred_val, (int, float)):
                if abs(ref_val - pred_val) > 1e-6:
                    differences.append(f"Row {idx}, Col {col}: ref={ref_val}, pred={pred_val}")
            elif ref_val != pred_val:
                differences.append(f"Row {idx}, Col {col}: ref={ref_val}, pred={pred_val}")
    
    if differences:
        print(f"{sheet_name}: Found {len(differences)} differences in sample:")
        for diff in differences[:10]:  # Show first 10
            print(f"  {diff}")
        return False
    
    return True

# Compare first two sheets
all_match = True
for sheet_name in ['20s Statistics', '40s Statistics']:
    ref_df = pd.read_excel(ref_path, sheet_name=sheet_name)
    pred_df = pd.read_excel(pred_path, sheet_name=sheet_name)
    
    match = compare_dataframes_by_column_name(ref_df, pred_df, sheet_name)
    print(f"{sheet_name}: Data content match = {match}")
    all_match = all_match and match
